narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Each number leaves two, so the total leaves two as well.
<bookmark mark='slide'/>Look at the three leftovers of two, and slide them together into one group.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That group has six dots, and six dots make one more full group of six.
